candidates.mechanism: Long-only 'buy yesterday's loser' of a correlated pair, gated on correlation stress: each day hold whichever of KO/PEP had the lower previous-day return, but only when the 9-day rolling correlation of their 19-day returns is below 0.9; a losing day is held one more day.
candidates.title: NZDUSD relative_value (QR-A-QN-001)
candidates.falsifier: no expectancy difference between low- and high-correlation states
